Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by geopolitical tensions pushing oil prices higher and a direct warning about potential weakness in chip stocks. This is a double whammy for your tech-heavy, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -53.92% and marked "SELL" – its leveraged nature amplifies this pain. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also down -33.48% and needs close watching. SMH is also in the red at -10.9%.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on the broader chip sector performance and any further signs of weakness. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for accelerated decay.

Bottom line: Risk management on your leveraged and underperforming chip positions is paramount today.
plays: Re-evaluate your SOXL stop; at -53.92% and "SELL" status, consider trimming or exiting to manage extreme drawdown on margin.
Monitor SPAL closely; its -33.48% loss on a new, leveraged position demands attention to prevent further decay.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The chip sector warning suggests caution, not adding new positions.
